data.narrative: Grouped SkillSwap into 12 work items then a visual DAG with hard/soft edges. Critical path is Listings→Slots→Booking→Cancel contract→Refund (13d). BREAK cycle (vetting↔admin↔data) was treated as a design problem and fixed by splitting a minimal review tool from the full dashboard and adding pending listing status.
